name: Sign-in Demo
summary: Shows who is visiting: the identity a celld site or a Hamstr grain receives.
description:
A small demo of platform sign-in. It shows the name, role and permissions the platform passes to the app, an admins-only page that the server guards, and where each value comes from.

The same code runs as a standalone celld site behind the celld auth service (X-Celld-User-* headers) and as a Hamstr grain (X-Hamstr-* headers). It has no sign-in code of its own, stores nothing and never reaches the network.

permissions.title: Open the admins page
permissions.description: See the page that only admins can open.
